authority_basis.summary: Record the corrected component-resolved source pair-to-triple differential and source weight profiles.

operations.title: The corrected source weight page retains small Tate top layers
operations.body: Using one H0 generator for connected elliptic pairs and two deck-component generators for split rational pairs, with sheetwise maps off branch and merged maps at ramification nodes, the source pair-to-triple differential has cokernel ranks 4,4,12. Corrected profiles are (20,15,0,4), (20,19,8,4), and (20,22,10,12).

operations.title: Component-resolved source pair-to-triple rank audit
operations.body: The checker constructs exact signed matrices termwise using pair component type and triple shared-node incidence, obtaining three stable rank profiles across all 28 terms.

operations.title: Benincasa computes the corrected source-associated four-site page
operations.body: Entry 1189 rebuilds the actual source pair→triple differential with split-pair H0 rank2. Cokernel W6 ranks are 4,4,12. Corrected source profiles: (W3,W4,W5,W6)=(20,15,0,4)x4,(20,19,8,4)x4,(20,22,10,12)x20. These supersede Entry 1187 for source terms. Remaining types are unchanged: middle variation, Tate surface lattices, up to five elliptic pairs, and small Tate/Kummer top cokernels. Next is deck/Kummer representation and cyclic transport of W6.
